underdog.heading: Why Missouri State can keep it close
bullets: Depth: Missouri State 54.0 (#38 of 133) vs SMU 53.7 (#69 of 133) — 31 places on the national board.

The outcome range is 15.1 points wide at one sigma — p10 +2.3 to p90 +46.3 for SMU, so a projection of +25.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 3%.

The market disagrees by 9.2 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
